WITH media_type_avgs AS (
  SELECT mt.MediaTypeId, AVG(t.UnitPrice) as avg_price
  FROM MediaType mt
  LEFT JOIN Track t ON mt.MediaTypeId = t.MediaTypeId
  GROUP BY mt.MediaTypeId
),
baseline AS (
  SELECT AVG(avg_price) as baseline_price
  FROM media_type_avgs
  WHERE avg_price IS NOT NULL
)
SELECT 
  mta.MediaTypeId,
  mta.avg_price,
  mta.avg_price / b.baseline_price as ratio
FROM media_type_avgs mta
CROSS JOIN baseline b
ORDER BY 
  CASE WHEN mta.avg_price IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END,
  mta.avg_price / b.baseline_price DESC
LIMIT 10
